# E-Notary Dubai

> E-Notary Dubai is a document drafting and notarization support service in Dubai, UAE. We prepare and coordinate Powers of Attorney (POA), MOFA attestation, legal notices, corporate documents, wills, and affidavits. Notarization happens through Dubai Courts or the UAE Ministry of Justice via a video call. We are a facilitation and support service — not a law firm and not a notary public.

Languages: English (/en/), Arabic (/ar/), Russian (/ru/), Chinese (/zh/), Spanish (/es/). All service pages are available in all five languages.
